## mep status

- `mep status [--topic T] [--who NAME] [--json]` prints a live snapshot, one line per entry: what is on you, what waits on others (each with its latest note), and every GitHub PR your open items ref, read from `gh` at run time (state, review decision, CI, head sha). A PR `gh` cannot read keeps its line with the error; an open item whose PRs are all merged or closed is flagged with `mep done ID`.
